{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute response rates by arm
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
treatment_rate = response_rates['treatment']
control_rate = response_rates['control']

treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Print the exact numbers used in evidence
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm: {len(df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment'])}")
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].sum()}")
print(f"Number of patients in control arm: {len(df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control'])}")
print(f"Number of responders in control arm: {df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].sum()}")
print(f"Response rate - treatment: {treatment_rate}")
print(f"Response rate - control: {control_rate}")
print(f"Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect}")"}
